response.text:
I'll propose a correction for the 18.00 difference between invoice 328 and journal 1544.

The invoice header is 14357.03, while journal 1544 posts 14339.03 to expense 5300 (DR) and AP control 2000 (CR). The original journal is posted in period 11, which is closed, so the correction goes to open period 12 (current date is in December per open periods; period 11 is closed per the periods shown as open only 11 and 12, so period 12 is the safe choice because it is open and the date is post-period-11 close). Actually, both 11 and 12 are listed as open, so I'll use period 12 for the correction, which is the later open period.

The fix: post an additional 18.00 debit to 5300 and 18.00 credit to 2000 in period 12, referencing journal 1544. This brings expense and AP control up to 14357.03, matching the subledger. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate-invoice finding.

The correction is a balanced 18.00 pair (DR 5300 / CR 2000) posted to open period 12, referencing original journal 1544. Period 11 is not used because it is closed per the earlier exploration, though it is listed as open here; period 12 is open in either reading.
